name: no-org-scope
description: The degenerate tenant for the scoped-id scheme: /api/orgs returns nothing, so there is no resolved organization to fall back on and the software read is skipped. Device 8001 carries its own organization_id and must import scoped by it -- automox:9999:8001 -- proving the row's organization_id needs no /api/orgs help. Device 8002 carries no organization_id, and with no resolved organization either there is nothing API-provided to scope a stable id with: it must be SKIPPED WITH A LOG LINE rather than emitted bare (which collides across tenants) or under an invented scope (which would change once org resolution works again, re-identifying the record). Real /api/servers rows always carry organization_id, so the skip is a guard for a shape the API should never produce -- but it must be loud when it happens.

log_contains: automox: no organizations returned; software will be skipped and the device listing left unscoped
automox: skipping device 8002: no organization_id on the record and no resolved organization to scope a stable id
